title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: Built this site for DSC 106 with HTML, CSS and JavaScript: a responsive layout with CSS Grid, a navigation menu and dark mode switcher generated in JavaScript, and project data loaded from a JSON file.

title: Professional League of Legends Match Analysis
description: Analyzed 25,058 professional LoL match records to identify which team statistics most separate wins from losses, engineering kill-pace and objective-control features and tuning a random forest with 5-fold GridSearchCV.

title: Job and PO Tracking Tool
description: Developed a job and PO tracking tool with React, TypeScript, Express, and Azure SQL, giving purchasing and planning teams real-time status visibility in place of email chains.

title: Student Happiness and Housing Analysis
description: Modeled 2,000+ student survey records via linear regression, revealing a statistically significant housing-happiness link, and built interactive Tableau visualizations across demographic and academic subgroups.

title: Wizard Chess
description: Created a fantasy chess engine in C++ with 6 polymorphic piece classes and an interactive Qt GUI, detecting checkmate and stalemate via exhaustive legal-move simulation verified with GoogleTest.

title: Power BI Reporting Dashboards
description: Delivered 20+ Power BI dashboards with automated daily refreshes, backed by Python ETL pipelines and SQL analysis of 2+ years of customer transaction data.

title: Depression Risk Classifier
description: Prototyped a rule-based depression risk classifier on 1,000+ YouTube samples, using the OpenAI Whisper API for transcription and tuning thresholds toward recall.
